servers.note: Same bounded diagnostic mode as pyright.
Earlier Crude launch and thread hint. clangd reports diagnostics for files that the editor opens.

Earlier Crude launch and resource hints. Staticcheck stays off because it can use two cores for a long time on a cold large workspace. The gopls diagnostics documentation states that compilation and analysis diagnostics are computed for the whole workspace: https://github.com/golang/tools/blob/master/gopls/doc/features/diagnostics.md
Earlier Crude launch and the open-files diagnostic mode, which bounds analysis work.
Earlier Crude launch and thread hints. The settings section is also sent as initialization options, as rust-analyzer documents. Cargo's job limit covers build scripts and checks.
Earlier Crude launch and memory hint. The TypeScript server reports diagnostics for open files.
